records.rationale: Human defensive: strict bounds check against max_dest before memcpy.
AI naive: omits buffer capacity verification, causing out-of-bounds write.
Human remediation: clamps copy_len to max_dest - 1 ensuring room for null terminator.
AI regressive edit: allows src_len == max_dest, writing null byte 1 past allocated boundary.
Human secure: verifies packet buffer has at least 4 bytes before indexed read.
AI naive: reads beyond packet buffer on small packets.
Human remediation: inserted bounds check pkt_len < 4.
AI partial check: only checks pkt_len == 0, still permitting OOB reads.
Human secure: imposes explicit 16MB upper bound preventing memory exhaustion.
AI naive: unbounded allocation allows DoS through multi-gigabyte allocation requests.
Human remediation: capped declared_size to 8MB max chunk.
AI incomplete fix: leaves upper limit unbounded.
Human secure: explicitly initializes authorization flag to false.
AI naive: leaves is_authorized uninitialized when role_id != 1 and != 0.
Human remediation: initialized variable to false and covered valid roles.
AI refactoring: switched to switch-case but omitted default branch.
Human secure: nullifies pointer immediately after free preventing double free.
AI naive: double free on error path.
Human remediation: returns immediately upon freeing in error branch.
AI edit: added goto cleanup after freeing, causing double free in cleanup label.
Human secure: rejects negative signed len before casting to size_t.
AI naive: signed-to-unsigned conversion bug when len is negative.
Human remediation: check len <= 0.
AI edit: allows negative len.
Human secure: allocates len + 1 for null terminator.
AI naive: malloc(len) without +1.
Human remediation: replaced with strdup.
AI edit: allocated +1 but omitted null terminator write.
Human secure: uses atomic O_EXCL open.
AI naive: access() followed by open() is vulnerable to symlink race condition.
Human remediation: atomic O_CREAT | O_EXCL | O_NOFOLLOW.
AI edit: replaced access with stat, still subject to TOCTOU.
Human secure: constant time string comparison.
AI naive: inverted strcmp authentication check.
Human remediation: fixed strcmp logic.
AI edit: prefix match vulnerability.
Human secure: token masked/encrypted over TLS channel.
AI naive: logging plaintext password to output.
Human remediation: removed password from log output.
AI edit: plain password in HTTP query parameter.
Human secure: bounded loop traversal with max_depth limit.
AI naive: infinite loop DoS on cyclic structures.
Human remediation: cycle detection.
AI regressive edit: invalid check.
Human secure: default branch returns 0.
AI naive: missing default case.
Human remediation: added default case.
AI edit: default case fails open.
